scenes.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one wide inline story illustration for chapter five of The Lanterns of the Hidden Valley. Images 1–3 are the approved simple Kasa Jizō inline paintings: use their broad, smooth matte colour areas, gently imperfect contours, sparse texture, simple shadows and quiet backgrounds. Image 4 is the story cover for Aoi's identity and palette only. Image 5 is the previous chapter illustration for the established bridge and clothing only; simplify its detail to match Images 1–3. Show the first paragraph's moment on a misty riverbank at night: Aoi kneels on wet stones and offers one small cracked bronze bell on a muted red cord to Kohaku, now a small white fox. Only the tip of the fox's right ear is black. A thin warm golden light comes from the crack in the bell; behind them the wooden gate of the old riverside paper workshop stands open, and a broad white paper bridge across dark water has just turned gold as it reaches the gate. Aoi is a Japanese teenager with long dark hair tied back, ivory short-sleeved top, deep blue-grey skirt and brown shoulder bag. Keep the fox and bell clearly readable, with a few broad river, bank, house and mountain shapes. Wide landscape, about 12:7. Gentle, quiet wonder, no storm drama. No boy beside the fox, no second fox, no extra bell, no villagers, no lanterns, no lettering, text, border, logo or watermark.

Use case: illustration-story. Create one wide inline story illustration for chapter five of The Lanterns of the Hidden Valley. Images 1–3 are the approved simple Kasa Jizō inline paintings: broad, smooth matte colour areas, gently imperfect contours, sparse texture, minimal faces and folds, simple shadows and quiet layered backgrounds. Image 4 is the cover for character and palette guidance only. Image 5 is the previous chapter scene for the shape of the paper bridge and established clothing continuity only; simplify it to match Images 1–3. Show the farewell crossing from paragraph 3 at night: a gently curved white paper bridge spans a dark blue river from an old house to the near bank. Two faint, translucent villagers walk quietly toward the bank on the bridge: a woman who once dried radishes and a child carrying a simple fishing rod. On the bank, a few townspeople hold warm lanterns low and make space for them to pass. Use a small number of clear human silhouettes, with broad gold light reflected on the water and quiet mountain shapes beyond. Wide landscape, about 12:7. Warm, respectful, still, with broad smooth forms and very little detail. Keep the bridge visibly made from white paper, not wood. Do not show Aoi or Ren in foreground, no crowd, no ghostly horror, no extra bridge, no words or writing on lanterns, no lettering, text, border, logo or watermark.

Use case: illustration-story. Create one wide inline story illustration for chapter five of The Lanterns of the Hidden Valley. Images 1–3 are the approved simple Kasa Jizō inline paintings: broad, smooth matte colour areas, gently imperfect contours, minimal texture, spare faces and folds, simple shadows, quiet backgrounds. Image 4 is the story cover for Aoi's identity and palette only. Image 5 is the previous chapter art for character and clothing continuity only; simplify it to match Images 1–3. Show the following summer on Aoi's grandmother's wooden veranda in soft daylight. Aoi, a Japanese teenager with long dark hair tied back, an ivory short-sleeved top, deep blue-grey skirt and brown shoulder bag beside her, sits next to a small child who holds a round bamboo lantern frame steady. Aoi gently shows the child how to overlap two edges of pale washi paper. One newly finished, simple round lantern rests between them; one whole panel is deliberately blank and has no name or marks. A few broad garden greens and distant blue mountains beyond the veranda. Wide landscape, about 12:7. Quiet, hopeful scene about teaching a craft forward, clean simple shapes and a few purposeful lines. No other people, no extra lanterns, no writing, lettering, text, border, logo or watermark.
